narutoloading.ytdlp.subtitle: Download video and audio with yt-dlp
narutoloading.ytdlp.download.title: Download
narutoloading.ytdlp.download.subtitle: Fetch a stream straight into the loading-screen sources folder
narutoloading.ytdlp.status.hint.desc: Pick yt-dlp below and it is copied into the game folder, or put it there yourself, add it to PATH, or set ytDlpDir to its absolute folder in the config file.
narutoloading.ytdlp.link.desc: A single video page; playlists are ignored
narutoloading.ytdlp.name: File name
narutoloading.ytdlp.name.desc: Without the extension; the video is saved as name.ext and the audio as name.audio.ext, so the two pair up automatically
narutoloading.ytdlp.name.hint: e.g. Naruto Mobile Tenth Anniversary Login CG
narutoloading.ytdlp.action.note.desc: The buttons stay disabled while yt-dlp is running. The video is saved as <name>.<ext> and the audio as <name>.audio.<ext>; the two are paired into one entry automatically.
narutoloading.ytdlp.status.install.done: Copied %s into the game folder; yt-dlp is ready
narutoloading.ytdlp.status.install.faile: Could not copy the file; see the log
narutoloading.ytdlp.status.unplayable: Saved as %s, but it cannot be read yet — configure FFmpeg on the Playback page
narutoloading.help.title: Help
narutoloading.help.subtitle: What the mod does, how media is organised and which tools it needs
narutoloading.help.about.purpose.desc: NarutoLoading replaces the vanilla loading screens with media from your folder: the video is drawn behind the progress bar and the matching audio plays along.
narutoloading.help.about.when.desc: The title screen, the world-loading screen and the end screen use the video. Once a world is loaded the player stops and the game music comes back.
narutoloading.help.about.open.desc: Use "Config" in the mod list, or press Ctrl+V while no text field has focus and the download page opens with the copied link filled in.
narutoloading.help.sources.folder.desc: Defaults to the "narutoloading" folder next to mods/ and can be changed on the settings page. Downloads land here too.
narutoloading.help.sources.pair.desc: Files are grouped by base name: naruto.mp4 plus naruto.m4a is one entry with picture and sound. A video alone plays muted, an audio file alone plays on its own.
narutoloading.help.sources.formats.desc: Video: mp4, mkv, webm, mov, m4v, avi, flv. Audio: ogg, opus, mp3, flac, wav, m4a, aac.
narutoloading.help.sources.mode.desc: Random, sequential or a fixed name, set on the settings page. The playback page can switch the current entry at any time.
narutoloading.help.download.install.desc: Download yt-dlp.exe from the official release page. There is no installer, the single executable is all you need.
narutoloading.help.download.pick: Telling the mod where it is
narutoloading.help.download.pick.desc: Press "Choose yt-dlp file" on the download page. The file is copied into the game folder and its folder is written to ytDlpDir in the config, so both survive a restart.
narutoloading.help.download.name: Names and overwriting
narutoloading.help.download.name.desc: A download is saved under the name you typed: the video as <name>.<ext>, the audio as <name>.audio.<ext>. Downloading the same kind again replaces that file, which is how you refresh an entry.
narutoloading.help.download.reload.desc: The media list is rescanned as soon as a download finishes. If you moved yt-dlp yourself, press "Detect again" instead of restarting.
narutoloading.help.ffmpeg.why.desc: ffmpeg decodes every video frame, and ffprobe reads duration, frame rate, resolution and channel count. Without them the mod can neither index nor play any media.
narutoloading.help.ffmpeg.both.desc: Both binaries must come from the same build and sit in the same folder (ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe on Windows). One without the other is not enough.
narutoloading.help.ffmpeg.where.desc: Pick their folder with "Choose FFmpeg folder" on the playback page, or drop them into the game folder, or add them to PATH. The first location that contains them wins.
narutoloading.help.ffmpeg.restart.desc: Choosing a folder stores it in ffmpegDir and locates both binaries again. The playback page shows the paths actually in use.
narutoloading.help.ffmpeg.trouble.desc: The log then contains "Cannot find executable ffmpeg". Check that the folder holds both files, then press "Detect again" on the playback page.
narutoloading.screen.subtitle: Loading media, downloads and playback
narutoloading.playback.title: Playback
narutoloading.playback.subtitle: Pick what plays on the loading screen and adjust its volume
narutoloading.playback.pick.desc: Switching restarts playback with the new entry
narutoloading.playback.note.desc: The player stops once a world is loaded; the selection is kept for the next loading screen.
narutoloading.playback.volume.desc: Audible right away, saved with the config
narutoloading.playback.mute: Mute vanilla music while the video has sound
narutoloading.playback.mute.desc: Only applies when the loading video carries an audio track
narutoloading.playback.ffmpeg.note.desc: The chosen folder must contain ffmpeg and ffprobe; they can also live in the game folder or on PATH. Applied immediately.
narutoloading.config.title: Settings
narutoloading.config.subtitle: Written to config/narutoloading.properties
narutoloading.config.width.desc: Wider videos are scaled down, keeping the aspect ratio
narutoloading.config.height.desc: Taller videos are scaled down, keeping the aspect ratio
narutoloading.config.buffer.desc: A larger buffer smooths playback out but uses more memory
narutoloading.config.shimmer.desc: A moving highlight runs across titles, cards and control labels
narutoloading.config.shimmerStrength.des: How much the highlight blends the base color away
narutoloading.config.shimmerFps.desc: Frames per second; lower costs less
narutoloading.config.fade.desc: Buttons, the logo and text fade out while the mouse stays still, and come back on any input; changes apply immediately
narutoloading.config.fadeTicks.desc: Ticks without mouse movement before the fade starts (20 ticks = 1 second)
narutoloading.config.fadeOutStep.desc: Alpha points removed per tick after fading starts
narutoloading.config.fadeInStep.desc: Alpha points restored per tick while the mouse is active
narutoloading.config.sourcesDir.desc: A relative path is resolved against the game directory
narutoloading.config.mode.desc: How the next media is picked between loading screens
narutoloading.config.fixedName.desc: Used by the Fixed mode; an unknown name falls back to random
narutoloading.config.debug.desc: Prints the frame decoding cost to the log
narutoloading.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
